title: Post Malone Teases New Song ‘Bad Mood’ That’ll Transport You Right Back to His ‘Beerbongs & Bentleys’ Era
summary: "eternal buzz coming soon," the musician teased of his upcoming album.
body: Post Malone is definitely not in a bad mood about dropping new music soon, with the musician sharing a snippet of a track on his upcoming album Eternal Buzz that had him cheesing while listening to it. In the clip posted to Instagram on Wednesday (Oct. 28), Posty sits on a couch while drinking a beer as he rocks out to a track called “Bad Mood,” based on the lyrics and the hashtag he added, “#badmood.” “Guess I’m doomed,” he sings on the catchy reverb-drenched track. “Didn’t think things through/ What did I do? … Sorry I was in a bad mood.” “eternal buzz coming soon 😤😤 love you mofo’s,” he wrote in the caption, referencing the title of his next album. Fans have suspected for a while that the hitmaker was planning a return to his signature melodic pop style of hip-hop, and based on the new teaser, it seems like they might’ve been correct. “Bad Mood” sounds like it could’ve come straight from the era of Beerbongs & Bentleys , his three-week Billboard 200 -topping 2018 album. title: بالفيديو: سداسية بافارية.. صيباري وأوليسي يقودان مهرجان أهداف بايرن ميونخ في الكأس
summary: المغربي يتألق ويسجل
